hypothesis: The configured model can execute a bounded campaign segment and continue from its native checkpoint with memory, action history and cumulative usage preserved.
notes: A distinct development condition from the original legacy-runner probe; do not pool their results as one comparison.
max_steps bounds each segment; dispatch, token and returned-cost limits apply cumulatively across the campaign.
The model selects advance_ticks within max_advance_ticks; ticks_per_step is retained for loader compatibility, not a forced simulation advance.
A native checkpoint is written at a clean segment end or clean pre-dispatch budget pause. Failed decisions retain diagnostics and require recovery from the last valid checkpoint.
The retained starting snapshot is not a fresh embark. This test does not establish year-two viability or a model ranking.
